16.basis: PostgreSQL 16.15 is a reviewed supported libpq prerequisite when the loaded library reports that version. The collector uses psycopg.pq.version(), not psql, server version, or runner documentation. This entry does not attest the entire host OS or imply libpq is bundled in a wheel. The upstream latest-patch check remains mandatory.

18.basis: PostgreSQL 18.6 is a reviewed supported libpq prerequisite when the loaded library reports that version. The collector uses psycopg.pq.version(), which reports the loaded library through PQlibVersion. PostgreSQL lists release line 18 as supported through 2030-11-14. This entry does not attest the entire host OS or imply libpq is bundled in a wheel; psql and server versions do not establish the loaded libpq version. The upstream latest-patch check remains mandatory.
